_about: Central SBA regulatory data for feasibility-study-company.com. Every value carries the REGISTER id (docs/web-fsc-2/REGISTER.csv) that verifies it against the primary text. Pages render these values through scripts/regulatory.py marker regions <!--sba:KEY-->...<!--/sba:KEY-->. Edit this file, run `python3 scripts/regulatory.py`, commit the pages it rewrites.

sop.name: SOP 50 10 8.1 with Technical Policy Updates
sop.applies_to: applications received by SBA on or after October 1, 2026

coo_basis.value: historical EBITDA over total post-transaction debt service, on the last fiscal year-end or the average of the last two

coo_projections.value: projections are reviewed but cannot meet the floor, except an owner-occupied Special Purpose Property acquisition whose price the appraised value fully supports, where the floor may be met on projections within two years

standard_7a_basis.value: historical and/or projected, with 1:1 global coverage; start-ups reach 1.15x within two years

small_7a_basis.value: historical or projected, plus the two most recent months of business bank statements; projections must reach 1.10x within one year; does not apply to changes of ownership

sba_504_basis.value: historical EBITDA over combined post-transaction debt service, last fiscal year-end or two-year average; projections analysed only where history falls short

coo_initial_acquisition.note: of total project cost; cannot be reduced or eliminated

coo_other.note: Business Expansion, Owner Buyout (on the purchase price) and ESOP & Cooperative; a lender may reduce or waive it for Business Expansion and Owner Buyout with adequate liquidity and no negative net worth

limited_sources_cap.note: seller debt on full standby, other full-standby debt and non-controlling minority investors (under 20%) together may supply no more than half of the required injection

counts_as_equity.value: out-of-pocket cost of the business valuation and QoE

startup_7a.note: of total project cost for a Start-Up Business (one year or less of revenue)

sba_504_new_or_special.note: New Business (two years or less) or Limited or Special Purpose Property

earnouts.value: seller earnouts prohibited; buyer rebates must pay down the 7(a) loan; purchase-agreement working-capital true-ups are not rebates

debt_cap.value: total acquisition debt, including seller debt not on full standby, is capped at the business valuation; any excess must be equity

sba_504_split.value: Third Party Lender 50%, debenture 40%, borrower 10%; debenture 35% at a 15% contribution and 30% at 20%

internal_valuation_max.note: Business Purchase Price at or below which the lender may value the business itself, unless buyer and seller are closely related

business_purchase_price.value: the purchase-agreement price less the appraised value of owner-occupied commercial real estate

qoe_threshold.note: Business Purchase Price, Initial Acquisition and Business Expansion only; measured before equity, seller debt or other financing

qoe_exempt.value: Owner Buyout, ESOP & Cooperative, and any acquisition of an owner-occupied Special Purpose Property

qoe_cash_proof.value: trailing twelve months plus the last two fiscal years

qoe_buyer_ordered.value: usable when one of the lender's approved vendors reviews it and the review is in the file; never a report prepared by or for the seller

special_purpose_definition.value: a limited-market property with a unique physical design, special construction materials, or a layout that restricts its utility to the use for which it was built

value: Cold storage facilities where more than 50% of total square footage is equipped for refrigeration
Farms, including livestock and dairy facilities
Hospitals, surgery centers, urgent care centers, and other health or medical facilities
Hotels, motels, and other lodging facilities
Nursing homes, including assisted living facilities
Service centers (e.g., oil and lube, brake, or transmission centers) with pits and in-ground lifts
special_purpose_list.note: SBA's example list in the 504 chapter; not all-inclusive. Self-storage, restaurants, day care and dealerships are not on it; Appendix 15 names storage units and hotels as examples of special purpose acquisitions where the real estate fully secures the loan.

coo_amortization_years.note: business portion of a change-of-ownership loan; real estate may be a separate loan or blended, with only the real estate portion above 10 years

coo_special_purpose_max_years.note: whole loan, when 85% or more of the use of total project costs is real estate and the owner-occupied Special Purpose Property is integral to the business

coo_special_purpose_threshold.note: of the use of total project costs, not of value

mixed_purpose_7a.value: blended maturity, or up to 25 years when 51% or more of proceeds are real estate; not available for changes of ownership

sba_504_maturities.note: 25-year maximum for real estate, 10-year minimum for machinery and equipment; with both, the maturity follows the asset category that is the majority of loan proceeds

sba_504_third_party_min_term.value: 7 years for a 10-year debenture, 10 years for a 20- or 25-year debenture
sba_504_third_party_min_term.note: the Technical Updates removed the August prohibition on the bank loan amortizing beyond the debenture term

transient_test.value: more than 50% of the prior year's revenue from transients who stay 30 days or less at a time; a start-up shows it in projections

max_504.note: aggregate gross debentures; $5.5 million per project for small manufacturers and energy public policy projects

combined.note: when the 7(a) loan is approved first and the 504 loan second; Policy Notice 5000-879058, effective July 4, 2026

source.value: Federal Register 2025-19072 (90 FR 47117), 504 loans approved on or after October 1, 2025

prime.source: Federal Reserve H.15, release of October 9, 2026

peg_prior.note: prior quarter, as reported in the fact sheet; not verified from a primary notice and not rendered on any page

value: 3.5% of the guaranteed portion up to $1,000,000, plus 3.75% above $1,000,000

annual_7a.note: of the outstanding guaranteed balance, paid by the lender

waiver_7a.note: upfront fee on loans of $700,000 or less to manufacturers (NAICS 31-33), the listed food supply chain codes, and businesses in a rural area

value: food supply chain (NAICS 1111, 1112, 1113, 1121, 1122, 1123, 1124, 1125, 1129, 1141, 1151, 1152, 423820, 4244, 4245, 424910, 445110, 484220 and 484230 limited to refrigerated and frozen trucking, farm products, grain and livestock, 493120, 493130)
businesses located in a rural area

rural_definition.value: a county that the U.S. Census Bureau has defined as at least 30 percent rural

waiver_504.value: both 504 fees waived for the same three categories, including 504 refinance loans

feasibility_study.value: 13 CFR 120.160(b): SBA may require professional appraisals, a survey, or a feasibility study

sop8.name: SOP 50 10 8
sop8.coo_equity: 10%, seller standby debt up to half
sop8.coo_amortization: blended, or 25 years when 51% or more of proceeds were real estate
sop8.internal_valuation_max: $250,000 of the amount financed net of real estate and equipment
sop8.small_7a_standard: FICO SBSS score of at least 165
sop8.jobs_504: $90,000 per job; $140,000 small manufacturers and energy

august_8_1.name: SOP 50 10 8.1 as issued August 14, 2026 (never in force)
august_8_1.source: IN 5000-882227's list of principal changes is the only primary record of the August wording
august_8_1.trust_guaranty: a different threshold, per SBA's notice; the August figure is in no primary document
august_8_1.special_purpose_amortization: 10-year cap with no special purpose exemption
august_8_1.qoe_buyer_ordered: no provision for a buyer-commissioned report
august_8_1.mixed_purpose_7a: no primary record of a different August wording; the notice restates the rule
august_8_1.tpl_term: bank loan could not amortize beyond the debenture term
